lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three to four visible horizontal rows of circular high-luminance spots extending from the mid-body towards the posterior, showing roughly equidistant spacing within the rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where spots are positioned at the nodes of the vertical and horizontal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and a deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, approximately midway between the base and the apex.
